brands.name: Jye Byrnes Surfboards
brands.short_description: Custom surfboards handcrafted in Newcastle, NSW. Jye Byrnes has been shaping boards for surfers of all levels from his Islington factory for 30 years.

models.name: Anchovy Quad

models.name: JBean

I wanted the board to be on the smaller side in length, channelling the egg concept by compressing the volume so the wide point was just past centre. This board has a relaxed, flat rocker making it a great paddler. For the bottom contour, a slight single concave flows into a double concave - vee tail.
